policy: Only primary experiments or institutional test reports are used. Published aggregates are retained with their device, operating condition, extraction method, uncertainty status, and word-model mapping assumptions.

sources.title: Study of Multicell Upsets in SRAM at a 5-nm Bulk FinFET Node
sources.device_technology: custom single-port and two-port SRAM arrays, 5-nm bulk FinFET

extracted_statistics.quantity: MCU event fraction under alpha exposure below 550 mV
extracted_statistics.extraction_method: conservative lower bound from the paper statement that MBUs contribute more than 15% for both SRAM designs
extracted_statistics.confidence_interval: not reported for this extracted statement
mapping_assumptions: the interval is scenario-specific and not pooled with neutron or FPGA data

extracted_statistics.value: an upset within three cells of an existing cluster member is assigned to the same MCU
mapping_assumptions: physical cell distance cannot be converted to logical word adjacency without a layout/interleaving map

sources.raw_data_search_status: No public raw address/coordinate archive was identified from the paper, DOI, or institutional record as of the audit date.
sources.spatial_resolution: Published cluster shapes and cell-distance rule; no reusable physical-to-logical address map.
sources.transformation_to_72bit: Only multiplicity/cluster intervals can constrain a synthetic 72-bit support.
sources.licensing_and_redistribution: Public manuscript accessible through OSTI; no separate raw-data license or redistribution grant was identified.

sources.title: Statistical Method to Extract Radiation-Induced Multiple-Cell Upsets in SRAM-Based FPGAs
sources.device_technology: Xilinx 7-Series, UltraScale, and UltraScale+ SRAM FPGA CRAM; 7-Series BRAM

extracted_statistics.confidence_interval: not published in reusable numeric form
not published in reusable numeric form
not published in reusable numeric form

mapping_assumptions: device-family values define a sensitivity range, not a pooled population confidence interval
CRAM/BRAM physical addresses are not mapped directly to a 72-bit SRAM word
sources.raw_data_search_status: The method states that radiation campaigns collect upset-cell lists, but no reusable list was identified in the public paper/institutional pages as of the audit date.
sources.spatial_resolution: Frame/bit logical offsets and reconstructed shape frequencies are reported in aggregate.
sources.transformation_to_72bit: A device-specific frame/bit-to-word and interleave map would be required before replay.
sources.sample_independence: scrub-cycle and event associations are not available in reusable raw form
sources.licensing_and_redistribution: Public manuscript is available; IEEE text carries reuse restrictions and no raw-data license was identified.

sources.title: Evaluating Built-in ECC of FPGA On-chip Memories for the Mitigation of Undervolting Faults
sources.device_technology: commercial FPGA block RAM under voltage underscaling

extracted_statistics.quantity: additional faults detectable but not correctable

mapping_assumptions: correctable is treated as an SBU aggregate only because the authors attribute the result to single-bit faults
the 7% detected category is not converted to a bit-exact DBU PMF
sources.raw_data_search_status: No public per-read fault-map archive or source repository was identified from the paper/title/author search as of the audit date.
sources.spatial_resolution: Published correctable/detectable rates; no public bit coordinates used here.
sources.transformation_to_72bit: Only the reported multiplicity coverage interval is used; no vectors are synthesized from plots.
sources.licensing_and_redistribution: Public arXiv manuscript; no separate experimental-data license or redistribution grant was identified.

sources.title: Hardware Versus Software Fault Injection of Modern Undervolted SRAMs
sources.device_technology: 28-nm 16-Kbit SRAM fault maps from commercial FPGA BRAM experiments

extracted_statistics.quantity: faulty SRAM maps with 2, 4, 6, and 8 faulty bits
extracted_statistics.extraction_method: reported histogram percentages among faulty maps

extracted_statistics.value: faults cluster by column and exhibit voltage inclusion

mapping_assumptions: persistent faulty-bit count per SRAM macro is not event multiplicity within one ECC word
spatial locality is used as a structured uncertainty constraint, not as a direct transient PMF
sources.raw_data_search_status: The paper says hardware-guided maps were used, but no legally reusable map archive or accompanying license was identified from repository and data-catalog searches as of the audit date.
sources.spatial_resolution: Original experiment used 16-Kbit maps; this audit has only published counts and spatial aggregates.
sources.transformation_to_72bit: Requires original coordinates, macro geometry, word slicing, and an explicit interleave map.
sources.sample_independence: maps may share device/voltage structure; independence cannot be established from aggregates
sources.licensing_and_redistribution: Public arXiv manuscript; no raw-map license or redistribution grant was identified.

sources.title: Xilinx Kintex-UltraScale Field Programmable Gate Array Single Event Effects Heavy-Ion Test Report
sources.device_technology: Kintex UltraScale FPGA BRAM, 256 RAMB36 blocks, 8-bit data width

extracted_statistics.value: post-processing classifies 1-bit, 2-bit, 3-bit, and higher errors with stated >=95% event-association confidence
extracted_statistics.confidence_interval: histogram values were not recoverable from the public report text used here

mapping_assumptions: methodological evidence only; no numeric PMF constraint is instantiated without the histogram
sources.raw_data_search_status: The public test report documents collection methodology but the underlying event file was not identified as a downloadable dataset.
sources.spatial_resolution: BRAM multiplicity categories in the report methodology.
sources.transformation_to_72bit: Would require the raw event file plus RAMB36 address and word-layout metadata.
sources.sample_independence: not recoverable without event timestamps/run identifiers
sources.licensing_and_redistribution: NASA technical report is public; no separate raw-event archive or data license was identified.

evidence_level_definitions.A_raw_bit_exact_experimental: Raw event vectors with experiment identity, geometry/word mapping, and redistribution terms.
evidence_level_definitions.B_measurement_derived_replay: Released or author-supplied pattern replay with traceable transformation but incomplete original coordinates.
evidence_level_definitions.C_literature_aggregate: Published multiplicity/spatial aggregates used only as ambiguity constraints.

conclusion: The available evidence supports source-specific aggregate ambiguity sets, not one pooled measured word-level PMF. Literature-derived and synthetic artifacts remain separate.
